name: agentic-sop-kit
description: Convert human SOPs into deterministic agentic workflows — linear or as a bounded graph (typed handoff edges, unique field ownership, bounded back-edges, static topology validation). Bundles the six-rung-ladder + agentic-sop + agentic-workflow-audit skills, the /sop-flow skill, a project-scoped Stop-hook regression gate, and the portable agentic-sop-kit.

max_fix_retries.title: Max auto-fix retries
max_fix_retries.description: Ceiling on auto-fix re-runs per run-id, shared by the fix-loop and the Stop-hook regression gate. The SOPKIT_MAX_FIX_RETRIES env var overrides it.

stall_window.title: Stall window
stall_window.description: Consecutive identical failures that count as no progress (0 disables stall detection). The SOPKIT_STALL_WINDOW env var overrides it.

keep_runs.title: Run dirs to keep
keep_runs.description: How many run dirs run.py --prune keeps (newest first). The SOPKIT_STATE_KEEP_RUNS env var overrides it.
